entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi... um, I'm calling about my VeloBand Pulse. I think I need to return it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
Yes, my name is Alex Chen, and the order number is VF78-9901.

Thank you, Alex. I have your order right here for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, it works fine, I guess. I... I just changed my mind. It was a bit of an impulse buy, and I really don't use it. I'm so confused about the policy. Can't you just help me?
Of course, Alex, I'm here to help. It's no problem at all. Let me just review the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Okay, I've checked our policy, and you're unfortunately outside the 10-day return window.
Oh, really? That's such a relief. I was so worried I had missed the deadline.

Not at all. Since it was delivered 41 days ago, you're perfectly fine. I've just initiated the return for you. I'm sending an email right now with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack the VeloBand Pulse back in its original box and drop it off at any post office.
Wow, that's fantastic. Thank you so much, Diana! You've been a great help.
You're very welcome, Alex. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that was it. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
